audience: sales teams that keep deals, client companies and quotes in Zomentum

useCases.title: Review the deals in each pipeline stage
useCases.text: Count opportunities per pipeline stage. Then list the deals with their value, close date and owner, and filter them to one pipeline.

useCases.title: Prepare a call with a client company
useCases.text: Search the workspace for a company. Read its contacts, opportunities and comments before the call.

useCases.title: Check the status of a quote or proposal
useCases.text: List documents with their status, number and recipients. Read the revisions and signers of one document. Share a short-lived PDF link only with people who may read it.

useCases.title: Review sales tasks and their due dates
useCases.text: List sales tasks with their due date, priority, completion state and linked record.

useCases.title: Add a follow-up task and a comment
useCases.text: Create an open task with a due date, linked to an opportunity, client company or contact. Add a comment to a record. The author must be a team member.
